Key Responsibilities Define and evolve the enterprise Observability and AIOps strategy, architecture principles, target architecture and roadmap. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Splunk architecture, observability, monitoring, and enterprise IT operations Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Deep Splunk architecture expertise is therefore essential, as you will lead the design of the platform that brings this vision to life. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Splunk architecture, observability, monitoring, and enterprise IT operations Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Mandatory expertise in enterprise Splunk architecture across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Strong expertise in telemetry, service monitoring, SLI/SLO management, event management, AIOps, operational analytics, and user experience monitoring.
